faq: Which file formats can you upload from?

Spreadsheets in CSV or Excel, supplier files and shared folders of photos all work. If your data is messy, we tidy the columns first and show you a sample before the full upload. Tell us your store platform in the order form.
Will you overwrite products already in my store?

Only if you ask. By default we add new products and leave existing ones alone. If you want current items updated, we match them by SKU or handle and confirm the match rule with you before changing anything.
Do you write the product descriptions?
We upload the text you send us. If descriptions are missing, we can use the facts from your supplier data, or you can order our product descriptions service for properly written copy on each page.
What do you need from me to start?

Your product data, your image files or links, and staff or collaborator access to your store. We never ask for your password. We also ask for pricing rules, such as the currency and whether prices include tax.
desc:
Bulk product upload for online stores gets your catalog live without weeks of typing. Ecom Swift LLC takes your spreadsheet, supplier file or photo folder, adds every product with its title, price, variants, stock and images, and reports back on what went live.

## What does a bulk product upload involve?

A bulk upload adds many new products to your store in one organized job. We take your source, whether it is a spreadsheet, a supplier file or a folder of photos with a price list, and turn each item into a finished product page. Each page carries a title, price, stock count, variants, images and a collection.

It differs from a data import in a simple way. An import moves data that is already structured. An upload often starts from rougher material and includes the matching, entering and checking that make the products ready to sell.

## Why uploads need a checking step

Adding products in volume is where small errors multiply. A shifted column puts prices under the wrong titles. A missing image leaves an empty box on a collection page. A size entered as a separate product instead of a variant splits stock in two.

Each mistake is fixable, but fixing hundreds after launch costs more than doing it right once. A final check for duplicates and missing data catches these problems before a customer does.

## How a clean upload helps the business

Product pages are what sell. When every item has a clear title, a visible price, a working variant selector and sharp images, shoppers can buy without hesitation. Stock counts that are correct from the start prevent the awkward email telling someone their order cannot ship.

Uploads also set up later work. Tags, product types and collections assigned at upload let filters and automatic collections work immediately. Search titles and meta fields filled in at the start save you a second pass over the catalog. And a short guide on adding products means the next batch matches the first.

## What a ready-to-sell upload includes

- Titles written to a single, consistent pattern.
- Prices and stock counts entered for every product and variant.
- Variants and options set up for sizes, colors or materials.
- Main and additional images attached in the right order.
- Products placed in the correct collections.
- Tags and product types assigned for filters and automatic rules.
- Search titles and meta fields filled in.
- A check for duplicates, empty fields and wrong prices.
- A test of a sample product on a phone.
- A test order on a sample item, where the package includes it.
- An upload report listing what went live and what needs your answer.

## How we do the upload

First we read your source and note anything unclear, such as two products with the same name or a price missing from a row. We send those questions together, so you answer once instead of many times.

Then we build the product sheet, upload it in batches and review the live pages. The Basic package puts a small group of products live with prices, stock and a main image. Standard adds variants, several images per product, collection placement and a test order on a sample product. Premium covers a larger number of products with tags, product types, search fields, a duplicate and missing-data check and a short guide for adding products later.

We do not write descriptions as part of an upload unless you add that service, but we can use text you provide.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Give each product a unique SKU or code.
- Name image files after the product they belong to.
- Tell us which items are new and which already exist in the store.
- Keep your source file safe as a reference.

**Avoid:**
- Sending product lists with half the prices missing.
- Mixing sizes and colors in one title instead of using options.
- Uploading over existing products without agreeing the rule first.
- Putting stock numbers in a note column that no one maintains.

## Who this service is for

It suits a new store owner with a supplier price list and a folder of photos. It suits a retailer adding a seasonal range of many items. It also suits a shop owner who is moving from selling in person to selling online and has nothing digital yet except a list.

## What we need from you

Send your product list, photos and any details we need, such as prices, stock and sizes. Staff or collaborator access is enough for the job, and a password is never needed. Please tell us whether products should go live straight away or stay as drafts until you have reviewed them.
